The '''RZ7-6113-23 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] of [[RZ7-6113-23]].
